queries_run: PACCAR credit rating OR guidance cut OR downgrade 2026 truck demand

findings.claim: PACCAR 為 CMI 最大客戶，2025 年占合併淨銷售 13%（2024、2023 各 16%），是唯一超過 10% 的客戶；供應協議不保證特定數量，失去該客戶或其車款產量大減將對營運與財務產生不利影響。
findings.excerpt: PACCAR is our largest customer, accounting for 13 percent of our consolidated net sales in 2025, 16 percent in 2024 and 16 percent in 2023.

findings.claim: 對 PACCAR 的銷售額約 44 億美元（2025）、54 億（2024）、55 億（2023）；無其他客戶超過 10%。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 8 Financial Statements
findings.excerpt: Worldwide sales to this customer were approximately $4.4 billion, $5.4 billion and $5.5 billion for the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, representing 13 percent, 16 percent and 16 percent, respectively, of our consolidated net sales. No other customer accounted for more than 10 percent of consolidated net sales.

customer_concentration_credit.note: 客戶信用面：搜尋僅得二手聚合站（marketscreener、newser 等），未見 PACCAR 2026 信評調降或正式下修財測的一手來源，不予採信為 claim。
